chunks: From him, from Nuh ibn Shu'ayb, from one of our companions, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:
The gleam of musk could be seen in the parting of the hair of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).
ai.seo_question: What physical sign of musk was visible in the Prophet's hair?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the physical manifestation of the Prophet's spiritual purity (zuhd) and divine light (nur), a concept central to Shia theology regarding the Imams' inherited excellence. The 'gleam of musk' in the parting of his hair serves as a tangible sign of his inner sanctity, linking his physical beauty to his moral and spiritual status. This detail is often cited in discussions of the Prophet's unique creation and the continuity of his blessed attributes through the Ahl al-Bayt.
